interpretationLimits: The 100 ms value is the target schedule; actual QPC sample intervals vary and the whole-address-space scan duration was not separately bracketed.
The observer performs VirtualQueryEx over committed regions and cached mapped-file lookups; its cost is not negligible or independently calibrated here.
MEM_IMAGE and MEM_MAPPED totals are mapping census values, not private-byte ownership or CPU attribution.
Cross-process comparisons use mapped type and basename, not absolute virtual addresses; process-specific file IDs and addresses are retained only in private raw files.
The ten-snapshot tail is descriptive, not a predeclared stability test or performance acceptance window.
A final empty snapshot can occur if the process exits while its address space is being enumerated; it is retained and reported, not treated as stable empty memory.
MEM_PRIVATE-type committed bytes are a VirtualQueryEx type subtotal and do not have to equal the application report's process PrivateBytes counter.
No allocation owner, causality, or performance acceptance is inferred. Primary native reports and their metrics are unchanged.
scope: Separately declared descriptive VirtualQueryEx census. Mapping/region categories are not process-private bytes or working-set attribution; no causal or performance acceptance claim.
